description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Vision transformers are robust learners in the Evaluation Analysis area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Vision transformers are robust learners”. The page names Sayak Paul, Pin-Yu Chen as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
